changes.text: Plays on torii are sent. It needs tosu-torii instead of tosu.
Watching a replay of your own score on lazer showed it as a new play.
Play analysis. Click the chart icon on a play to see your timing, how each finger and hand did, your long note releases, and what to work on. You can turn it off in the settings.

A skin editor. Color columns, outline parts, resize art, and move HitPosition, ColumnStart, ColumnWidth, ColumnSpacing, the judgement line, judgements, combo and StageBottom. Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y undo and redo.
Save edits straight into your lazer skin, without Edit externally. Switch skins and back in lazer to see them.

Open your skin in a window the size of osu!'s and play the selected map in it with its song. Watch autoplay or play on your keys, judged like stable or lazer at the map's OD and mods. osu! goes quiet while it plays.
Leaderboards for your country, continent, a subregion like Southeast Asia, your friends, or any player, past the top 50.
Sending plays and sharing your live status can both be turned off, and plays you finish still stay in Hashi for their analysis.
Plays weren't sent on Linux when osu! wasn't in osu-winello's default folder.
Always on top, from the pin in the title bar or in the settings.
This changelog, shown after an update.
Plays in multiplayer rooms weren't sent.
Plays on maps without a leaderboard linked to an empty one.
Right-click menu only shows on text boxes and links.
Text and images can't be selected or dragged.
Title bar icon follows the theme color.
Avatar and profile color could be out of date.
Retrying from the results screen was taken for watching a replay, so the play wasn't sent.
Data folder renamed from mania-bridge to Hashi. The old one is moved over on start.
Sends finished osu!mania plays to Mania Tracker through tosu.
Map leaderboards, with your rank on each play.
Live status on your profile while osu! is open.
Theme color, dans and lazer mod badges.
Downloads and starts tosu if you don't have it.
